text: つかいかたを　ぶんしょうで　くわしく　かいせつします

structure.jp: くわしく　かいせつします

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says what you use to do something. ぶんしょうで = 'in writing, with text'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.span: くわしく　かいせつします
patterns.explanation: Changing the final い of a describing word to く lets it tell how an action is done. くわしく かいせつします = 'explains in detail'.
